an3.132:1.1: 133 tayome bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ
an3.132:1.3: pāsāṇalekhūpamo puggalo paṭhavīlekhūpamo puggalo udakalekhūpamo puggalo.
an3.132:1.5: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati
an3.132:1.6: so ca khvassa kodho dīgharattaṃ anuseti
an3.132:1.7: seyyathāpi bhikkhave pāsāṇe lekhā na khippaṃ lujjati vātena vā udakena vā ciraṭṭhitikā hoti
an3.132:1.8: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati
an3.132:1.9: so ca khvassa kodho dīgharattaṃ anuseti
an3.132:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati
an3.132:2.3: so ca khvassa kodho na dīgharattaṃ anuseti
an3.132:2.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave paṭhaviyaṃ lekhā khippaṃ lujjati vātena vā udakena vā na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti
an3.132:2.5: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati
an3.132:2.6: so ca khvassa kodho na dīgharattaṃ anuseti
an3.132:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo āgāḷhenapi vuccamāno pharusenapi vuccamāno amanāpenapi vuccamāno sandhiyatiyeva saṃsandatiyeva sammodatiyeva
an3.132:3.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave udake lekhā khippaṃyeva paṭivigacchati na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti
an3.132:3.4: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco puggalo āgāḷhenapi vuccamāno pharusenapi vuccamāno amanāpenapi vuccamāno sandhiyatiyeva saṃsandatiyeva sammodatiyeva
an3.132:3.6: ime kho bhikkhave tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
